We introduce the Segment Anything (SA) project: a new
task, model, and dataset for image segmentation. Using our
efficient model in a data collection loop, we built the largest
segmentation dataset to date (by far), with over 1 billion
masks on 11M licensed and privacy respecting images. The
model is designed and trained to be promptable, so it can
transfer zero-shot to new image distributions and tasks. We
evaluate its capabilities on numerous tasks and find that
its zero-shot performance is impressive – often competitive
with or even superior to prior fully supervised results. We
are releasing the Segment Anything Model (SAM) and cor-
responding dataset (SA-1B) of 1B masks and 11M images at
https://segment-anything.com to foster research into foun-
dation models for computer vision.

As segmentation masks are not abundant on the inter-
net, we built a data engine to enable the collection of our
1.1B mask dataset, SA-1B. The data engine has three
stages: (1) a model-assisted manual annotation stage, (2) a
semi-automatic stage with a mix of automatically predicted
masks and model-assisted annotation, and (3) a fully auto-
matic stage in which our model generates masks without
annotator input. We go into details of each next.

ject points using a browser-based interactive segmentation
tool powered by SAM. Masks could be refined using pixel-
precise "brush" and "eraser" tools. Our model-assisted an-
notation runs in real-time directly inside a browser (using

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The reported gains are corroborated by evaluations on external benchmarks not used for training and by human raters using a detailed rubric, with paired statistical tests confirming significant quality differences [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0044, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0056, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0157].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Headline outcomes are established through zero-shot mIoU on 23 unseen datasets, standard external metrics on BSDS500 and LVIS, and blind human mask-quality ratings [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0043, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0058, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0061, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0065].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: SAM is trained with focal and dice losses against ground-truth or model-assisted masks, with minimum-loss backpropagation over multiple predicted masks and MSE supervision for the predicted IoU ranking head [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0023, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0114, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0115].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding zero-shot generalization, promptability, and dataset scale align closely with the reported ablation studies, baseline comparisons, and human evaluation scores [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0012, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0055, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0070]. Where SAM underperforms on supervised benchmark-specific metrics (e.g. COCO AP), the paper clearly explores annotation bias and confirms that human raters favor SAM masks [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0065, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0066].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Empirical evaluation is extensive and rigorous, spanning zero-shot single-point segmentation across 23 diverse benchmarks, edge detection on BSDS500, object proposal generation on LVIS v1, and instance segmentation on COCO and LVIS [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0041, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0044, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0058, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0061, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0065]. Crucially, standard mIoU/AP metrics are corroborated by large-scale human evaluation studies with detailed rubrics and rigorous paired statistical tests confirming significant visual quality gains [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0056, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0157].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Extensive evaluations on completely unseen external benchmarks and human perceptual ratings provide separate, objective validation of mask quality and zero-shot transfer [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0044, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0056, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0157].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Zero-shot transfer mIoU on a 23-dataset benchmark suite, standard external task metrics (BSDS500 ODS/OIS, LVIS AR@1000, COCO/LVIS mask AP), and blind human ratings of mask quality [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0043, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0058, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0061, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0065].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Focal loss and dice loss against ground-truth/annotated masks during simulated interactive multi-round prompting, plus MSE loss for predicted IoU ranking [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0023, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0114, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0115].

primary.limitations: The authors transparently document known limitations, including failure to resolve fine structures, occasional hallucination of small disconnected components, lower boundary sharpness relative to zoom-in methods, non-real-time full image encoding, and preliminary performance on text-to-mask prompting [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0075].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, specifying the MAE-initialized ViT image encoder, prompt encodings for sparse and dense prompts, an ambiguity-aware lightweight transformer mask decoder predicting multiple masks with minimum-loss backpropagation, and a three-stage data collection and filtering loop [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0021, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0023, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0025, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0029].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a transformative and foundational contribution to computer vision, accompanied by fully specified architectures, exhaustive experimental protocols across dozens of external benchmarks, and controlled human evaluations with rigorous statistical validation. There are no critical methodological or evaluation gaps.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces the Segment Anything project, consisting of a promptable segmentation task, the Segment Anything Model (SAM) with real-time promptable mask decoding, a three-stage data engine, and the SA-1B dataset comprising over 1 billion automatically generated masks across 11 million images [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0003, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0011, Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0021].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a transformative and foundational contribution to computer vision, accompanied by fully specified architectures, exhaustive experimental protocols across dozens of external benchmarks, and controlled human evaluations with rigorous statistical validation. There are no critical methodological or evaluation gaps.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors transparently document known limitations, including failure to resolve fine structures, occasional hallucination of small disconnected components, lower boundary sharpness relative to zoom-in methods, non-real-time full image encoding, and preliminary performance on text-to-mask prompting [Ec4bd9f968ad17dec-B0075].
